I found three Marrow Agrisupply sites and sent you the list in our DM.

- **Eastbank** comes from your message in #central-team on 9 Jun. Its receiving-door import is on ticket PD-4821. The file labels the doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02.
- **Pine Crossing** comes from Pree in #central-team on 9 Jun. The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen.
- **Gate 46** comes from Pree in #central-random on 14 Oct. They called it "one more site for Marrow Agrisupply" for a follow-up from this week and said no action was needed.

The **Wichita store** might be a fourth site, but I didn't count it. It's in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025, where Pree mentions an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher next to the Marrow office-hours room. The message never says Wichita is a Marrow site.

The 9 Jun thread also says three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just read "waiting," but it doesn't name those stores.

I took "this week's chat" to mean anything posted this week in the channels you're in. Our DM had nothing before your question. Nothing else about Marrow came up this week in #general, #help-it-ops or #inc-tansley-carrier-api. I only looked in channels you're a member of.
